description: This file contains functions for a Memcached cache storage plugin used in the Revive Adserver project, specifically for delivery cache management including retrieval, storage, initialization, and server management.

methods.name: _oxMemcached_getMemcache
methods.description: Returns the current Memcached or Memcache instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _oxMemcached_MemcachedInit
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Memcached or Memcache object, setting up server connections based on configuration.

methods.name: _oxMemcached_addMemcachedServer
methods.description: Adds a server to the Memcached or Memcache instance, parsing host and port from the server address string.
